policy: Seven independently scoped software IP assets with individual asking references and transfer perimeters. Each estimate covers its own existing first-party implementation. Internal modules are counted once inside their project; target-project rights and website repositories are excluded.

assets.name: LEARNPIANO
assets.description: Build focused piano practice around your own music, follow visual guidance and review your progress.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party piano practice, performance and local production software, its proprietary transcription work, retained research and validation, and documentation. User music, external scores, recordings, datasets, plugins and future model qualification are excluded.

assets.name: PLANTELOGIA Intelligence Platform
assets.description: Review supporting evidence and decision rules before adopting an intelligence workflow for your organisation.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party evidence-governed intelligence prototype, retained qualification, documentation and packaging. Production deployment, operational infrastructure, external evidence/data rights and future productisation are excluded.

assets.name: CAUSORYN
assets.description: Explore how changes could affect interconnected systems, compare alternative scenarios and review the recorded outcomes.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party linked-system modelling, scenario comparison, offline observation records and local coupled-simulation prototype, with retained source, tests, documentation and development packaging at the identified v0.6.0 source commit. Live telemetry, distributed operation, physical fidelity, production qualification, third-party ownership and future development are excluded.

assets.name: Software Asset Engineering Platform
assets.description: Inspect a software project, review its recorded evidence and limitations, and prepare a documented package for an acquisition review.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party local software-inspection, evidence, bounded review-proposal and package-preparation prototype, its CLI/local interface, source contracts, documentation and retained validation at the identified v0.1.0 commit. Ingested-project execution, arbitrary-code isolation, broader adapters, production SaaS, hosting, rights certification, third-party ownership and future development are excluded.

assets.name: Launch & Cislunar Transportation Engineering Platform
assets.description: Assess launch and lunar transport options for your FusionLunar studies, compare their assumptions and review the evidence needed for further engineering.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party transport-concept screening software, interface contracts, synthetic example, tests, documentation and retained software validation at the identified development commit. Physical vehicles, flight qualification, operational transport, external science and data rights, the separately owned FusionLunar asset and future engineering are excluded.

assets.name: Synthetic Consciousness Engineering Platform
assets.description: Explore controlled simulations of adaptive behaviour and compare recorded experiments to assess questions for further research.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party offline research software, corrected experimental derivative, implemented campaign-audit, multi-seed study and resumable-experiment controls, documentation and retained historical/final/checkpoint material counted once. Missing original historical data and weights, proven consciousness, numerical equivalence, external platform ownership, third-party rights, full-scale future GPU qualification and future research are excluded.

assets.name: Universal Video Intelligence Platform
assets.description: Control your video viewing, retain and recover your own research notes, and review project-specific leads before preparing software proposals.
assets.pricingScope: Present first-party v0.9.1 browser and offline research prototype, manual notes and backup recovery, source-review and human-supplied evidence review, documentation, tests and development packaging. Browser production qualification, AI transcript/multimodal analysis, media downloading, platform or target-project ownership, hosted services, automatic repairs and future engineering are excluded.

assets.name: Universal Remote Perception Intelligence Platform
assets.description: Plan controlled perception studies, preserve blind-study records and review what the recorded results can support.
assets.pricingScope: Existing first-party offline controlled-study, custody, scoring and IP-governance software, its documentation and tests, with a separately identified unmerged P1.2 candidate. Seven internal component records are counted once within this project. Physical sensing hardware, hidden-object inference, scientifically demonstrated anomalous or sensor-free perception, independent custody/security certification, third-party rights and future research are excluded.

assets.name: Universal Operations Orchestration & Intelligence Platform
assets.description: Model your operations, compare resource and workflow scenarios, and review proposed decisions before authorising execution.
assets.pricingScope: Existing first-party v0.4 offline operational modelling, planning, local event memory, controlled recovery, portable evidence and non-mutating policy-proposal software, tests and documentation. External actuation, authenticated identities, externally certified custody, deployed multi-user SaaS, production optimisation or autonomous execution and future development are excluded.

assets.name: Collective Reality Engine
assets.description: Explore shared fictional worlds, review the consequences of participant decisions and preserve a consistent history of each scenario.
assets.pricingScope: Existing first-party v0.3 local shared-world reference software, two bounded scenario implementations, local persistence/replay controls, tests and design documentation counted once. Future narrative production, external artwork/audio, AI models, online multiplayer, production identity, large-scale infrastructure and commercial event delivery are excluded.

assets.name: Mission-to-Execution Engineering Framework
assets.description: Turn your project aims into reviewed requirements, dependency-aware plans and planning documents with traceable decisions.
assets.pricingScope: Existing first-party offline mission, requirements, dependency-planning and document-generation software on main v0.1 plus separately frozen unmerged v0.2/v0.3 traceability and feasibility-declaration software, tests and methodology documents. Generated plans are design outputs; independently established feasibility, copied cross-project IP, automatic engineering or execution, hosted services and future implementation are excluded.

latestIdentityUpdate.boundary: Each new software project is counted once. The confirmed repository rename retains its existing project identifier and reference alias. Withdrawn identifiers are not reused.

previousIdentityUpdate.boundary: Universal Video Intelligence Platform is one independently scoped first-party prototype. Its internal research modules are not separately counted, and target-project assets and rights are excluded.

latestModuleRelationship.boundary: Launch & Cislunar Transportation Engineering Platform is the separately scoped launch and cislunar transport module for FusionLunar studies. The documented demand/result interface supports the relationship; this update does not establish a new shared runtime, completed end-to-end integration or flight-qualified transport. Both projects retain their own asset identity, price and transfer scope.
